/root/work/sign-product/send-venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import json
P='/root/worktrees/dealroom-sign-edd/counterparty-c2a-gate3-r26.jsonl'
n=0
for line in open(P):
    try: o=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    m=o.get('message') or {}
    c=m.get('content') if isinstance(m,dict) else None
    if not isinstance(c,list): continue
    for x in c:
        if isinstance(x,dict) and x.get('type')=='tool_use':
            cmd=x['input'].get('command') or json.dumps(x['input'])[:200]
            print(n, x['name'], len(cmd), repr(cmd[:150])); n+=1
EOF
